title: Login
story: As a user, I want to log in to my account so I can access my dashboard and continue where I left off.
ac: - Login form requires email address and password - Password field includes a show/hide toggle - Incorrect credentials show a clear error message - Successful login redirects to the correct dashboard based on account type — Team Builder goes to the Team Builder dashboard, Independent goes to the Independent dashboard - 'Forgot Password?' link available on login page - 'New to Hireable? Sign up' link available on login page - Session persists until user logs out

title: Sign Up as Team Builder
story: As an employer, I want to create an account so I can post jobs, review talent, and manage my hiring needs.
ac: - Sign up form requires: full name, email, password, company name - Email must be unique — duplicate emails show an error - Password must meet minimum requirements (8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number) - After submitting, user receives a verification email - Work Style Quiz is presented as a required step before accessing the dashboard - Completing the quiz generates workplace tags and work style profile - After quiz completion, user is redirected to the Team Builder dashboard - Account Setup Checklist is shown on first login

title: Sign Up as Independent Contractor
story: As a remote talent, I want to register on the platform so I can find jobs, join Trial Drives, and connect with employers.
ac: - Sign up form requires: full name, email, password, job title - Email must be unique — duplicate emails show an error - Password must meet minimum requirements (8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number) - After submitting, user receives a verification email - Work Style Quiz is presented as a required step before accessing the dashboard - Quiz asks 6 questions about work style, communication, and decision-making approach - Multiple choice answers available per question plus a free-text 'Something else' option - Completing the quiz generates workplace tags/badges visible on the talent's profile - After quiz completion, user is redirected to the Independent dashboard - Account Setup Checklist shown on first login

title: Reset Account Password

ac: - 'Forgot Password' link available on login page - Entering a registered email sends a password reset link - Unregistered email shows an error - Reset link expires after 24 hours - New password must meet minimum requirements - Success message shown after password is successfully reset - User is redirected to login page after reset

title: Duplicate a Job Post

title: Delete a Job Post

title: Reopen a Closed Job Post

title: Edit a Draft Job Post

ac: \* Edit option available in the three-dot menu on Draft job post cards only \* Clicking the Draft card or selecting Edit from the three-dot menu triggers the same behavior \* If draft was created from scratch — employer is redirected to the exact step where they left off with all previously filled fields retained \* If draft was duplicated from an existing job post — employer is redirected directly to the Review Job Post page with all fields pre-filled \* All fields are editable regardless of how the draft was created \* Save as Draft button available to save changes without publishing \* Publish option available in the three-dot menu on Draft cards — all required fields must be completed before publishing \* Clicking Publish changes the status from Draft to Active immediately \* Published role appears in All Roles with Active status and becomes visible to Independent Contractors \* If required fields are incomplete, publish is blocked and employer is prompted to complete missing fields

title: Request Proposal from Candidate

title: View Default Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a default objective and see its current status, remaining days, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track qualitative or binary objectives during the trial.
ac: \* Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Default), current status, remaining days, and start and end dates \* Status flow: No Update → Pending Approval → Achieved / Missed \* Status is updated by the Independent Contractor marking it as done — not by the Team Builder \* Discussions section shows threaded comments \* Recent Activity log shows all status changes with timestamps

title: View Automatic Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open an automatic objective and see progress calculated from connected key results, a breakdown of key result types, discussions, and recent activity so that I can understand how the Independent Contractor's key result completions are driving overall objective progress.
ac: \* Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Automatic), overall progress percentage, and Key Result completion count (e.g. 1/3 KRs) \* Progress is calculated automatically based on: Completed KRs / Total KRs (e.g. 2/3 = 67%) \* Donut chart shows breakdown of connected Key Result types: Manual, Automatic, Default \* Connected Key Results are listed with: title, type, progress, and status \* Discussions section shows threaded comments \* Recent Activity log shows all Key Result updates with timestamps \* Team Builder cannot manually update progress — driven by Key Result completion only

title: View Manual Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a manual objective and see the Independent Contractor's current value, progress, trend chart, performance heatmap, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track their numerical progress against a measurable target.
ac: \* Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Manual), current value, daily target, overall progress percentage, and update cadence \* Input format is displayed based on KPI type: \* Increase: +X (e.g. +5 calls) \* Maintain: X/Y (e.g. 12/100) \* Decrease: current value (e.g. 16) \* Progress is calculated as: Current Value / Target × 100 = Progress % \* Trend chart displays progress over time per update cadence \* Performance heatmap shows daily performance states: Overachieved, Achieved, At Risk, Missed, No Changes, N/A \* Discussions section shows threaded comments between Team Builder and Independent Contractor \* Recent Activity log shows all progress updates with timestamps \* Team Builder can view but cannot manually edit the Independent Contractor's logged values

title: View Key Result Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a specific key result connected to an automatic objective and view its progress and update method so that I can drill down into what is driving the objective's completion.
ac: \* Dashboard shows: Key Result title, type (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, remaining days, start and end dates \* Progress visualization matches the Key Result type \* Connected tasks are listed if the Key Result is Automatic \* Discussions section shows threaded comments \* Recent Activity log shows all updates with timestamps

title: View Task Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view the task dashboard under an automatic key result so that I can see all individual tasks and their completion status that are driving the key result's progress.
ac: \* Task Dashboard shows all tasks connected to an Automatic Key Result \* Each task shows: title, type, and completion status \* Tasks marked done by the Independent Contractor are reflected in real time \* Completing a task updates Key Result progress and Objective progress automatically \* Team Builder can view task completion but cannot modify or mark tasks

title: Approve Completed Objective
story: As a Team Builder, I want to approve an objective that the Independent Contractor has marked as done so that it can be officially retired from the activity tracker and counted as completed.
ac: \* Approve button is available when an objective status is Pending Approval \* A dashboard banner notifies the Team Builder when an Independent Contractor marks an objective as done \* Clicking Approve changes the objective status to Achieved \* Approved objective is retired from the activity tracker — no longer feeds the daily grid \* Independent Contractor is notified when their objective is approved \* Streak continues uninterrupted after Team Builder approves the objective \* If all objectives are approved and retired, tracker shows completed state and displays the final streak count \* Objective still feeds the activity tracker while awaiting approval — pending does not pause the streak

title: Reject Completed Objective
story: As a Team Builder, I want to reject an objective submission with a reason so that the Independent Contractor can address the revision and resubmit for approval.
ac: \* Reject button is available when an objective status is Pending Approval \* Team Builder must provide a reason before rejecting \* Rejecting changes the objective status back to Active — objective continues feeding the activity tracker \* Independent Contractor is notified of the rejection and the reason provided \* Independent Contractor can revise and resubmit — status returns to Pending Approval upon resubmission

title: Request Objective Revision
story: As a Team Builder, I want to flag an Independent Contractor's progress submission as needing revision with a reason code and supporting note so that I can formally request a correction without escalating to a full dispute.
ac: \* Request Revision button is available on any submitted objective or progress update during an active trial \* Team Builder must select a reason code before submitting: Missing Deliverable, Out-of-Scope Output, Missed Deadline, or No Report Submitted \* A supporting note field is required alongside the reason code \* Submission is marked as Revision Requested in the objective dashboard \* Independent Contractor is notified immediately when a revision is requested \* Only 1 revision request is allowed per reporting period \* If Team Builder does not respond within 24 hours of the Independent Contractor's revised submission, the period auto-approves and becomes earned

title: View Contract & Payment Tab
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view the contract terms and payment history for an Independent Contractor in the Contract & Payment tab so that I can review what was agreed upon and track financial activity during the trial.
ac: \* Tab shows: agreed job role, trial duration, start and end dates, agreed budget, payment schedule, and escrow status \* Payment history shows all transactions with: date, amount, type, and status \* Payment is held in escrow during the trial \* Tab is read-only — no editing available from this view

title: View Evaluation History
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view all submitted evaluations in the Evaluation tab so that I can reference past assessments for the Independent Contractor.
ac: \* Evaluation tab shows all evaluations submitted for the Independent Contractor \* Each entry shows: date submitted, star rating, and written feedback \* Finalized TFP score is shown after evaluation is submitted \* View is read-only — evaluations cannot be edited after submission \* Empty state shown if no evaluation has been submitted yet

title: Send Evaluation
story: As a Team Builder, I want to submit a post-trial evaluation for an Independent Contractor after the trial ends so that I can formally assess their performance and finalize their Trial Fit Score.
ac: \* Send Evaluation button is ONLY active after the trial end date has passed \* Button is greyed out and disabled during an active trial \* Evaluation form includes: star rating, written feedback, and overall recommendation \* Team Builder cannot submit the evaluation without completing all required fields \* Submitted evaluation is sent to the Independent Contractor as a notification \* TFP Phase 4 score updates after evaluation is submitted — Evaluation weight becomes 25% \* End Contract and Hire for Full-Time buttons unlock after evaluation is submitted \* Past evaluations are viewable in the Evaluation tab

title: End Contract
story: As a Team Builder, I want to formally end the trial contract after submitting my evaluation so that I can close the engagement and release the escrowed payment to the Independent Contractor.
ac: \* End Contract button is ONLY available after the evaluation has been submitted \* Button is greyed out and disabled if evaluation has not been submitted \* Confirmation prompt is shown before ending the contract \* Upon confirmation: contract status changes to Ended, escrowed payment is released to the Independent Contractor, and the Independent Contractor is notified \* File a Dispute remains available as an alternative to ending the contract \* Ended contract moves to inactive state on the All Independents list

title: Hire for Full-Time
story: As a Team Builder, I want to convert a trial Independent Contractor into a full-time hire after submitting my evaluation so that I can transition them into a permanent role when I'm satisfied with their trial performance.
ac: \* Hire for Full-Time button is ONLY available after the evaluation has been submitted \* Button is greyed out and disabled if evaluation has not been submitted \* Clicking opens the Full-Time offer form pre-filled with the Independent Contractor's details \* Team Builder sets: salary, exclusive benefits, and start date \* Submitted offer appears in Sent Offers \* Independent Contractor is notified of the full-time offer

title: File a Dispute
story: As a Team Builder, I want to file a dispute as soon as the trial ends so that I can raise concerns about payment or performance before closing the engagement.
ac: \* File a Dispute button is available immediately when the trial ends — no evaluation required \* Dispute form requires: reason, description, amount in question, and supporting evidence (optional) \* Team Builder cannot submit the dispute without completing all required fields \* Submitted dispute is sent to admin for review \* Independent Contractor is notified that a dispute has been filed \* Dispute appears in Sent Disputes with Pending status

title: Send Message to Independent Contractor
story: As a Team Builder, I want to send a message to an Independent Contractor directly from their trial dashboard so that I can communicate with them without leaving their profile.
ac: \* Send Message button is visible in the dashboard header at all times during an active trial \* Clicking Send Message opens the messaging interface with the Independent Contractor pre-selected \* Team Builder can compose and send a message without leaving the trial dashboard \* Empty message cannot be sent

title: View Full-Time Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view the full-time dashboard of an Independent Contractor so that I can monitor their ongoing performance, objectives, and contract details in one place.
ac: - Dashboard header shows: Independent Contractor name, role, and contract status badge (Full-Time, Active) - Summary stats bar shows: Assigned Objectives count and Completed Objectives count - Trial Fit Score widget is visible showing the final TFP score from the completed trial — read-only, does not update - Navigation tabs visible: Objectives, Contract & Payment, Evaluation - Send Message button is visible in the header at all times - File a Dispute button is visible in the header at all times - Objectives tab is the default view when the dashboard loads - Clicking Contract & Payment tab shows contract terms and payment history - Clicking Evaluation tab shows all submitted evaluations

title: View Objectives List
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view all objectives assigned to a full-time Independent Contractor so that I can monitor their ongoing work performance.
ac: - Objectives list shows all objectives for the full-time engagement - Each objective card displays: title, type badge (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, status pill, due date, and last update date - Objectives are NOT locked — new objectives can be created and assigned at any time - New objectives assigned by the Team Builder appear in the list immediately - Clicking an objective card opens the relevant objective dashboard

title: Create Objective
story: As a Team Builder, I want to freely create and assign new objectives to a full-time Independent Contractor at any time so that I can set and evolve performance goals throughout the ongoing engagement.
ac: - Create Objective button is always available on the Full-Time Dashboard — no locking - Form requires: title, description, type (Manual / Automatic / Default), and type-specific settings - Manual type requires: KPI type (Increase / Maintain / Decrease), target value, and update cadence - Automatic type requires: connected Key Results - Default type requires: no additional input — binary completion - Created objective appears in the Objectives List immediately - Independent Contractor is notified when a new objective is assigned

title: View Manual Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a manual objective for a full-time Independent Contractor and see current value, trend chart, performance heatmap, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track measurable performance over the contract period.
ac: - Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Manual), current value, daily target, overall progress percentage, and update cadence - Input format displayed based on KPI type: Increase (+X), Maintain (X/Y), Decrease (current value) - Progress calculated as: Current Value / Target × 100 = Progress % - Trend chart displays progress over time per update cadence - Performance heatmap shows daily performance states: Overachieved, Achieved, At Risk, Missed, No Changes, N/A - Discussions section shows threaded comments between Team Builder and Independent Contractor - Recent Activity log shows all progress updates with timestamps - Team Builder can view but cannot manually edit the Independent Contractor's logged values

title: View Automatic Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open an automatic objective for a full-time Independent Contractor and see KR-based progress, connected key results, discussions, and recent activity so that I can monitor completion-driven goals.
ac: - Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Automatic), overall progress percentage, and Key Result completion count - Progress calculated automatically based on: Completed KRs / Total KRs - Donut chart shows breakdown of connected Key Result types: Manual, Automatic, Default - Connected Key Results listed with: title, type, progress, and status - Discussions section shows threaded comments - Recent Activity log shows all Key Result updates with timestamps - Team Builder cannot manually update progress — driven by Key Result completion only

title: View Default Objective Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a default objective for a full-time Independent Contractor and see its current status, remaining days, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track qualitative or binary work goals.
ac: - Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Default), current status, remaining days, start and end dates - Status flow: No Update → Pending Approval → Achieved / Missed - Status is updated by the Independent Contractor marking it as done — not by the Team Builder - Discussions section shows threaded comments - Recent Activity log shows all status changes with timestamps

title: View Key Result Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a specific key result connected to an automatic objective and view its progress and update method so that I can drill down into what is driving the objective's completion.
ac: - Dashboard shows: Key Result title, type (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, remaining days, start and end dates - Progress visualization matches the Key Result type - Connected tasks are listed if the Key Result is Automatic - Discussions section shows threaded comments - Recent Activity log shows all updates with timestamps

title: View Task Dashboard
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view the task dashboard under an automatic key result so that I can see all individual tasks and their completion status that are driving the key result's progress.
ac: - Task Dashboard shows all tasks connected to an Automatic Key Result - Each task shows: title, type, and completion status - Tasks marked done by the Independent Contractor are reflected in real time - Completing a task updates Key Result progress and Objective progress automatically - Team Builder can view task completion but cannot modify or mark tasks

title: Approve Completed Objective
story: As a Team Builder, I want to approve an objective that the Independent Contractor has marked as done so that it can be officially counted as completed.
ac: - Approve button is available when an objective status is Pending Approval - A dashboard banner notifies the Team Builder when an Independent Contractor marks an objective as done - Clicking Approve changes the objective status to Achieved - Independent Contractor is notified when their objective is approved - Approved objective is retired from the active tracker - New objectives can be created and assigned to replace completed ones at any time

title: Reject Completed Objective
story: As a Team Builder, I want to reject an objective submission with a reason so that the Independent Contractor can address the revision and resubmit for approval.
ac: - Reject button is available when an objective status is Pending Approval - Team Builder must provide a reason before rejecting - Rejecting changes the objective status back to Active - Independent Contractor is notified of the rejection and the reason provided - Independent Contractor can revise and resubmit — status returns to Pending Approval upon resubmission

title: Request Objective Revision
story: As a Team Builder, I want to flag an Independent Contractor's progress submission as needing revision with a reason code and supporting note so that I can formally request a correction without escalating to a full dispute.
ac: - Request Revision button is available on any submitted objective or progress update during an active full-time contract - Team Builder must select a reason code: Missing Deliverable, Out-of-Scope Output, Missed Deadline, or No Report Submitted - A supporting note field is required alongside the reason code - Submission is marked as Revision Requested in the objective dashboard - Independent Contractor is notified immediately when a revision is requested - Only 1 revision request is allowed per reporting period - If Team Builder does not respond within 24 hours of the Independent Contractor's revised submission, the period auto-approves

title: View Contract & Payment Tab
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view the full-time contract terms, salary, exclusive benefits, and payment history so that I can keep track of the full financial engagement.
ac: - Tab shows: agreed job role, contract start date, base salary, exclusive benefits breakdown, and payment schedule - Exclusive benefits listed separately: Health Insurance, Government Contribution, Internet Allowance, Learning & Development Allowance - Payment history shows all transactions with: date, amount, type, and status - Tab is read-only — no editing available from this view

title: Send Evaluation
story: As a Team Builder, I want to submit a performance evaluation for a full-time Independent Contractor at any time so that I can provide ongoing feedback throughout the engagement.
ac: - Send Evaluation button is available at any time during an active full-time contract — not gated by an end date - Evaluation form includes: star rating, written feedback, and overall recommendation - Team Builder cannot submit the evaluation without completing all required fields - Submitted evaluation is sent to the Independent Contractor as a notification - Submitted evaluation appears in the Evaluation tab immediately

title: View Evaluation History
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view all submitted evaluations in the Evaluation tab so that I can reference past assessments for the Independent Contractor.
ac: - Evaluation tab shows all evaluations submitted for the Independent Contractor during the full-time engagement - Each entry shows: date submitted, star rating, and written feedback - Entries are sorted by most recent - View is read-only — evaluations cannot be edited after submission - Empty state shown if no evaluation has been submitted yet

title: File a Dispute
story: As a Team Builder, I want to file a dispute at any point during the full-time engagement so that I can raise concerns about payment or performance.
ac: - File a Dispute button is available at any time during an active full-time contract - Dispute form requires: reason, description, amount in question, and supporting evidence (optional) - Team Builder cannot submit the dispute without completing all required fields - Submitted dispute is sent to admin for review - Independent Contractor is notified that a dispute has been filed - Dispute appears in Sent Disputes with Pending status

title: Send Message to Independent Contractor
story: As a Team Builder, I want to send a message to an Independent Contractor directly from their full-time dashboard so that I can communicate with them without leaving their profile.
ac: - Send Message button is visible in the dashboard header at all times - Clicking Send Message opens the messaging interface with the Independent Contractor pre-selected - Team Builder can compose and send a message without leaving the full-time dashboard - Empty message cannot be sent

title: View Payments Overview
story: As a Team Builder, I want to see a summary of my total spending across all contracts so that I can quickly understand my overall payment activity on the platform.
ac: - Payments page shows a summary card with: total amount spent across all contracts - Summary is updated in real time as new transactions are recorded - Clicking a transaction navigates to the transaction detail view

title: View Transaction History
story: As a Team Builder, I want to see a full list of all payment transactions across all my contracts so that I can track my complete spending history in one place.
ac: - Transaction History shows all recorded payment activity across all contracts - Each row shows: date, contract name, Independent Contractor name, transaction type, amount, and status - Transaction types: Payment Deposited, Payment Released, Payment Refunded - Default sort by most recent - Pagination applied - Empty state shown if no transactions exist

title: Filter Transactions
story: As a Team Builder, I want to filter my transactions by contract, status, and date range so that I can narrow down records to find what I am looking for.
ac: - Filter options: by contract name, by status (Deposited, Released, Refunded), by date range - Filters can be combined - Active filters are visually indicated - Clearing filters restores the full list

title: Search Transactions
story: As a Team Builder, I want to search my transactions so that I can quickly locate a specific payment record.
ac: - Search bar available on Payments page - Searches by contract name or Independent Contractor name - Results update dynamically as Team Builder types - Empty state shown when no results match

title: View Transaction Detail
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a specific transaction to view its full details so that I can review the breakdown of a specific payment.
ac: - Clicking a transaction opens the detail view - Shows: date, contract name, Independent Contractor name, transaction type, amount, and status - Read-only view

title: View Sent Disputes
story: As a Team Builder, I want to see all disputes I have filed across all contracts in one list so that I can monitor the status of each dispute.
ac: - Sent Disputes page shows all disputes filed by the Team Builder across all contracts - Each row shows: date filed, contract name, Independent Contractor name, reason, and status (Pending / Resolved / Closed) - Default sort by most recent - Empty state shown if no disputes have been filed

title: View Dispute Detail
story: As a Team Builder, I want to open a specific dispute to view its full details and status updates so that I can stay informed on the process check outcome.
ac: - Clicking a dispute opens the full detail view - Shows: date filed, contract name, Independent Contractor name, reason, description, amount in question, supporting evidence, and current status - If resolved, shows: admin resolution notes and outcome - Read-only view

title: Withdraw Dispute
story: As a Team Builder, I want to withdraw a pending dispute so that I can cancel it if the issue has been resolved or I have changed my mind.
ac: - Withdraw button is available on Pending disputes only - Confirmation prompt shown before withdrawing - Dispute status changes to Withdrawn - Hireable admin is notified of the withdrawal - Independent Contractor is notified that the dispute has been withdrawn - Once withdrawn, a new dispute cannot be filed for the same contract

title: View Personal Profile
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view my personal profile so that I can see how my identity and details appear across the platform.
ac: - Profile shows: profile photo, full name, job title, and member since date - Read-only view

title: Edit Profile Photo
story: As a Team Builder, I want to update my profile photo so that I can ensure my identity is clearly represented across the platform.
ac: - Edit photo button available on personal profile - Supported formats: JPG, PNG (max 5MB) - Photo previewed before saving - Changes saved immediately - Updated photo reflects across the platform

title: Edit Full Name
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my full name so that I can keep my personal details accurate.
ac: - Edit name field available on personal profile - Changes saved immediately - Updated name reflects across the platform

title: Edit Position
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my job title so that Independent Contractors know my role within the company.
ac: - Edit job title field available on personal profile - Free text input - Changes saved immediately - Updated job title reflects across the platform

title: View Company Profile
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view my company profile so that I can see exactly how my company appears to Independent Contractors.
ac: - Company Profile shows: company logo, company name, description, industry, location, company URL, and work style badges - Public-facing — visible to Independent Contractors on job posts and Discover page - Read-only view

title: Edit Company Logo
story: As a Team Builder, I want to upload or update my company logo so that my brand is accurately represented to Independent Contractors.
ac: - Edit logo button available on Company Profile - Supported formats: JPG, PNG (max 5MB) - Logo previewed before saving - Changes saved immediately - Updated logo reflects on all active job posts

title: Edit Company Name
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my company name so that Independent Contractors see the correct company they are engaging with.
ac: - Edit company name field available on Company Profile - Changes saved immediately - Updated name reflects on all active job posts

title: Edit Company Description
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my company description so that I can give Independent Contractors a clear picture of what my company does.
ac: - Edit description field available on Company Profile - Character limit applies - Changes saved immediately - Updated description reflects on all active job posts

title: Edit Industry
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my company's industry so that Independent Contractors can assess whether my business is a good fit for their skills.
ac: - Edit industry field available on Company Profile - Searchable dropdown with predefined industry options - Changes saved immediately - Updated industry reflects on all active job posts

title: Edit Location
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my company's location so that Independent Contractors know where the company is based.
ac: - Edit location field available on Company Profile - Free text or searchable location input - Changes saved immediately - Updated location reflects on all active job posts

title: Edit Company URL
story: As a Team Builder, I want to edit my company URL so that Independent Contractors can visit our website to learn more.
ac: - Edit company URL field available on Company Profile - URL format validation applied - Changes saved immediately - Updated URL reflects on all active job posts

title: Retake Work Style Quiz
story: As a Team Builder, I want to retake the work style quiz from the Company Profile so that I can update my work style badges if my working preferences have changed.
ac: - Retake Quiz button available on Company Profile - Team Builder prompted to confirm before restarting - Completing quiz updates work style badges on Company Profile - New badges replace old ones immediately - Updated badges reflect publicly on Company Profile and affect matching compatibility with Independent Contractors

title: View / Edit Account
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view and edit my account information so that I can keep my basic account details current.
ac: - Account page shows: name, email, account type - Team Builder can edit name and email - Email change requires re-verification - Changes saved immediately

title: Change Password
story: As a Team Builder, I want to change my account password from the Security settings so that I can keep my account secure.
ac: - Form requires: current password, new password, confirm new password - New password must meet minimum requirements (8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number) - Incorrect current password shows an error - Success message shown after change

title: View Subscription Plan
story: As a Team Builder, I want to view my current subscription plan and available upgrade options so that I can manage my membership and access the features I need.
ac: - Shows current plan name, billing cycle, renewal date, and features included - Read-only view - CTA to upgrade or manage plan if applicable

title: Manage Payment Method
story: As a Team Builder, I want to add, update, or remove my payment method so that I can control how I am billed for my subscription and contracts on the platform.
ac: - Shows all saved payment methods - Team Builder can add new method, set default, or remove existing - Removal confirmation prompt shown - At least one payment method must remain active

title: View Dashboard Overview
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a personalized dashboard when I log in, so that I can quickly get an overview of my account activity and know what to do next.
ac: - Dashboard loads upon login showing all key widgets - Displays active contracts, recent messages, and account setup progress - All widgets are clickable and navigate to relevant sections - Personalized greeting shown with Independent Contractor's name

title: View Marketing Banner
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a marketing banner on my dashboard, so that I can stay informed about platform updates, promotions, or featured opportunities.
ac: - Marketing banner displayed prominently on dashboard - Banner can contain text, image, and CTA link - Banner is dismissible - Hidden if no active banner exists

title: Account Setup Checklist
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a checklist showing my account setup progress (Verify Email, Answer Work Style Quiz, Setup Profile, Setup Payment Method, Apply to Role), so that I can complete my profile and become fully ready to be hired.
ac: - Checklist shows 5 steps: Verify Email, Answer Work Style Quiz, Setup Profile, Setup Payment Method, Apply to Role - Completed steps marked with checkmark - Each step is clickable and navigates to the relevant section - Checklist disappears or collapses once all steps are completed

title: View Active Contracts
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see my active contracts on my dashboard showing the company, contract type, and role, so that I can quickly access my ongoing engagements.
ac: - Active contracts widget shows all ongoing Trial and Full-Time engagements - Each card shows company name, role, contract type, and days remaining or start date - Clicking a contract navigates to the relevant contract dashboard - Empty state shown if no active contracts

title: Quick Action Shortcuts
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see two quick action cards — Find Your Next Role (→ Roles) and Complete Your Profile (→ Profile) — so that I can navigate to the most important next steps directly from my dashboard.
ac: - Two quick action cards shown: Find Your Next Role (→ Roles) and Complete Your Profile (→ Profile) - Each card shows title, short description, and CTA button - Cards always visible on dashboard

title: Send Message
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to send messages to Team Builders, so that I can communicate about role opportunities, contracts, and objectives.
ac: - Independent Contractor can compose and send messages to Team Builders they have an active connection with - Message delivered in real time - Sent messages appear in conversation thread immediately - Empty message cannot be sent

title: Receive Message
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to receive messages from Team Builders, so that I can stay informed and respond to any communication related to my applications or contracts.
ac: - Independent Contractor receives messages from Team Builders in real time - New messages trigger a notification - Messages appear in correct conversation thread - Unread count updates automatically

title: Show Unread Indicator
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see an unread message indicator on my inbox, so that I know when I have new messages that need my attention.
ac: - Unread message count displayed on Messages nav icon - Count updates in real time - Count clears when conversation is opened

title: Search Messages
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to search through my messages, so that I can quickly find a specific conversation without scrolling through my entire inbox.
ac: - Search bar available within Messages module - Filters conversations by Team Builder name or keyword - Results update as user types - Empty state shown when no results match

title: Attach Files in Messages
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to attach files in my messages, so that I can share documents, portfolios, or deliverables with Team Builders directly in the chat.
ac: - File attachment button available in message composer - Supported types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PNG, JPG (max 10MB) - Attached file previewed before sending - Recipient can download from message thread

title: Start / Join Call
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to start or join a call from within the messaging interface, so that I can communicate with Team Builders in real time without leaving the platform.
ac: - Call button available within an active conversation - Clicking initiates or joins a call session - Call interface includes mute, camera toggle, and end call - Notification sent to other party when call starts

title: Browse Roles
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to browse all available role listings, so that I can explore opportunities that match my skills and interests.
ac: \* Roles page displays all available and active role listings \* Each card shows: company logo, role title, type (Trial / Full-Time), budget/salary, experience level, and match percentage \* Results load with pagination at the bottom \* Pagination shows: Previous, page numbers, and Next \* Empty state shown if no listings are available \* Search bar available on Roles page — searches by role title, company name, or skills \* Results update dynamically as Independent Contractor types \* Clearing the search bar restores the full list \* Filter options: role type (Trial / Full-Time), experience level, budget/salary range \* Multiple filters can be applied simultaneously \* Active filters are visually indicated \* Clearing filters restores the full list \* Match percentage displayed on each role listing card \* Color coded: green (high), yellow (medium), red (low) \* Phase 1 (Work Style only) shown before trial \* Phase 2 (+ Role & Profile) updates when profile is complete \* Tooltip explains what the score is based on \* Clicking a role card opens the full role details \* Role details show: company info, role title, type, description, required skills, experience level, budget/salary, and trial duration (if Trial) \* Apply button visible on role details page \* Match percentage prominently shown on role details page

title: Apply to Role
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to apply to a role listing, so that I can formally express my interest and be considered for the role by the Team Builder.
ac: \* Apply button available on role listing card and role details page \* Application submitted immediately upon clicking \* Independent Contractor cannot apply to the same role twice \* Team Builder is notified of the application \* Application appears in My Applications with Applied status

title: View All Applications
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see all the roles I've applied to in one list so that I can track where I am in the hiring process for each application.
ac: \* My Applications page shows all roles the Independent Contractor has applied to \* Each row shows: company logo, role title, type (Trial / Full-Time), date applied, current stage, and current status \* Pipeline stages and statuses per stage: \* Application Sent — no status \* Matched — no status \* Interview Requested — Awaiting Confirmation, Interview Confirmed, Interview Completed \* Proposal Requested — Awaiting Proposal, Proposal Submitted, Requested Revision by TB \* Offer Received — Awaiting Response, Offer Accepted, Declined \* Hired — Waiting to Start, Started, Contract Completed, Contract Terminated \* Clicking a row opens the full application detail view \* If an offer has been received, a Review Offer button is visible on the card \* Default sort by most recent \* Empty state shown if no applications exist

title: Accept Interview Invitation
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to accept an interview invitation from a Team Builder so that I can confirm my availability and move forward in the hiring process.
ac: \* Accept button is available when application stage is Interview Requested and status is Awaiting Confirmation \* Clicking Accept changes the status to Interview Confirmed \* Team Builder is notified that the interview has been accepted \* A meeting link is shown to the Independent Contractor after accepting \* Accept button is hidden once status moves past Awaiting Confirmation

title: Join Interview Call
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to join the interview call directly from my application so that I can attend the interview without leaving the platform.
ac: \* Join Call button is visible when application status is Interview Confirmed \* Clicking Join Call redirects the Independent Contractor to the meeting link in a new tab \* Button is only visible when interview has been confirmed — not before or after \* If the meeting link is unavailable, an error message is shown

title: Submit Proposal
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to submit my proposal to the Team Builder so that they can review my proposed objectives, rate, and timeline and decide whether to proceed with a trial offer.
ac: \* Submit Proposal button is available when application stage is Proposal Requested and status is Awaiting Proposal \* Proposal form requires: proposed objectives, rate, timeline, and optional proposal notes \* Independent Contractor cannot submit without completing all required fields \* Submitted proposal changes status to Proposal Submitted \* Team Builder is notified that a proposal has been submitted \* Submit button is hidden once proposal has been submitted

title: Revise Proposal
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to revise my proposal based on the Team Builder's feedback so that I can address their concerns and move closer to an agreement.
ac: \* Revise Proposal button is available when application status is Requested Revision by TB \* Independent Contractor can view the Team Builder's revision notes before editing \* Proposal form is pre-filled with the previously submitted proposal details \* Independent Contractor updates the relevant fields and resubmits \* Resubmitting changes status back to Proposal Submitted \* Team Builder is notified of the resubmission

title: View Offer
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view the full details of an offer sent to me by a Team Builder, so that I can review the terms before deciding to accept or decline.
ac: - Clicking View Offer opens the full offer details sent by the Team Builder - Shows: role, description, start date, duration/salary, objectives (if trial), exclusive benefits (if full-time) - Independent Contractor can accept or decline the offer from this view - Accepting moves the engagement to active contract status

title: Accept Offer
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to accept a trial offer from a Team Builder so that I can formally commit to the engagement and begin the trial.
ac: \* Accept Offer button is available when application stage is Offer Received and status is Awaiting Response \* Independent Contractor can review the full offer details before accepting — role, rate, trial duration, start date, and committed objectives \* Confirmation prompt shown before accepting \* Accepting the offer changes status to Offer Accepted and card transfers to Hired stage with status Waiting to Start \* Team Builder is notified that the offer has been accepted \* Contract is created and visible in the Contracts section \* Accept button is hidden once offer has been accepted or declined

title: Decline Offer
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to decline a trial offer so that I can remove myself from consideration if the terms are not a good fit.
ac: \* Decline button is available when application stage is Offer Received and status is Awaiting Response \* Independent Contractor can optionally provide a reason for declining \* Confirmation prompt shown before declining \* Declining changes status to Declined \* Team Builder is notified that the offer has been declined \* Card remains visible in My Applications with Declined status and a Review Offer button still accessible \* Decline button is hidden once offer has been accepted or declined

title: Message Team Builder
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to message a Team Builder directly from my application so that I can ask questions or discuss the opportunity without leaving the platform.
ac: \* Message button is available on each application card across all pipeline stages \* Clicking opens the messaging interface with that Team Builder pre-selected \* Independent Contractor can compose and send a message without leaving My Applications \* Empty message cannot be sent

title: View All Contracts
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a list of all my active and past contracts in one place so that I can quickly overview all my ongoing and completed engagements.
ac: - All contracts listed with: company name, role, contract type (Trial/Full-Time), status (Active/Ended), and days remaining or end date - Default sort by most recent - Empty state shown if no contracts exist

title: Filter Contracts
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to filter my contracts by type and status so that I can focus on specific engagements.
ac: - Filter by type: Trial, Full-Time - Filter by status: Active, Ended - Filters can be combined - Active filters visually indicated

title: Open Contract Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to click on a contract card to open the full contract dashboard so that I can access my objectives, performance data, and contract details for that engagement.
ac: - Clicking a Trial contract opens Trial Contract Dashboard - Clicking a Full-Time contract opens Full-Time Contract Dashboard - Back button returns to All Contracts list

title: View Trial Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my trial dashboard so that I can monitor my overall trial performance, objectives, activity, and fit score in one place.
ac: - Dashboard header shows: Team Builder company name, role, and contract status badges (Trial, Active) - Summary stats bar shows: Committed Objectives count, Completed Objectives count, and Days Left with trial date range - TFP widget shows overall score as a percentage broken down into: Performance, Profile, and Work Style — each with a progress bar and percentage - Tooltip explains how the TFP score is calculated and when the final score becomes available - Phase weights update automatically based on current phase: On Trial (Phase 3): Work Style 20%, Profile 30%, Performance 50% — Evaluation excluded Post Trial (Phase 4): Work Style 15%, Profile 20%, Performance 40%, Evaluation 25% - Objectives tab is the default view when the dashboard loads - Objectives list shows all objectives agreed upon at the time of the offer - Objectives are LOCKED — no new objectives can be added, modified, or removed during the trial - Each objective card displays: title, type badge (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, status pill, due date, and last update date - Status pills per objective type: Default: No Update → Pending Approval → Revision Requested → Achieved / Missed Manual: No Update → On Track → Off Track → Pending Approval → Revision Requested → Achieved / Missed Automatic: No Update → On Track → Off Track → Pending Approval → Revision Requested → Achieved / Missed - System automatically updates any active objective to Off Track when ≤ 7 days remain and progress is below 70% - Clicking an objective card opens the relevant objective dashboard - Activity Log visible showing a GitHub-style Mon–Fri daily grid - Each tile reflects: Green (all logged), Light Green (partial), Gray (nothing logged) - Current streak count and status label (Thriving / Idle / Unresponsive) displayed - Navigation tabs visible: Objectives, Contract & Payment, Evaluation - Send Message button visible in the header at all times - File a Dispute button visible in the header — available only after trial ends

title: View Default Objective Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a default objective and see its current status, remaining days, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track my binary objectives during the trial and know what I need to complete.
ac: Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Default), current status, remaining days, start and end dates Status flow: No Update → Pending Approval → Achieved / Missed Mark as Done button available to signal completion to Team Builder Discussions section shows threaded comments with Team Builder Recent Activity log shows all status changes with timestamps Team Builder approval is required before objective is marked as Achieved Read-only once status is Pending Approval — cannot be undone by Independent Contractor

title: View Automatic Objective Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open an automatic objective and see progress calculated from my connected key results, a breakdown of key result types, discussions, and recent activity so that I can understand how my key result completions are driving overall objective progress.
ac: Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Automatic), overall progress percentage, and Key Result completion count (e.g. 1/3 KRs) Progress is calculated automatically based on: Completed KRs / Total KRs (e.g. 2/3 = 67%) Donut chart shows breakdown of connected Key Result types: Manual, Automatic, Default Connected Key Results are listed with: title, type, progress, and status Clicking a Key Result navigates to the Key Result Dashboard Discussions section shows threaded comments with Team Builder Recent Activity log shows all Key Result updates with timestamps Independent Contractor cannot manually update progress — driven by Key Result completion only

title: View Manual Objective Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a manual objective and see my current value, progress, trend chart, performance heatmap, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track my numerical progress against the target.
ac: - Dashboard shows: objective title, type badge (Manual), current value, daily target, overall progress percentage, and update cadence - Input format displayed based on KPI type: Increase (+X), Maintain (X/Y), Decrease (current value) - Progress calculated as: Current Value / Target × 100 = Progress % - Trend chart displays progress over time per update cadence - Performance heatmap shows daily states: Overachieved, Achieved, At Risk, Missed, No Changes, N/A - Discussions section shows threaded comments with Team Builder - Recent Activity log shows all progress updates with timestamps - Update Progress button available to log a new value

title: View Key Result Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a specific key result connected to an automatic objective and view its progress so that I can understand what is driving the objective's completion.
ac: - Dashboard shows: Key Result title, type (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, remaining days, start and end dates - Progress visualization matches the Key Result type - Connected tasks listed if the Key Result is Automatic - Discussions section shows threaded comments - Recent Activity log shows all updates with timestamps

title: View Task Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view the task dashboard under an automatic key result so that I can see and complete all individual tasks driving the key result's progress.
ac: - Task Dashboard shows all tasks connected to an Automatic Key Result - Each task shows: title, type, and completion status - Independent Contractor can mark tasks as done directly from this view - Marking a task done updates Key Result progress and Objective progress automatically

title: View Contract & Payment Tab
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my contract terms and payment history in the Contract & Payment tab so that I can review what was agreed and track my payment activity.
ac: - Tab shows: agreed role, trial duration, start and end dates, agreed budget, and payment schedule - Payment history shows all recorded transactions for this contract with: date, transaction type, amount, and status - Transaction types: Payment Deposited, Payment Released, Payment Refunded - If a dispute has been filed for this contract, it is visible in this tab with: date filed, reason, and current status - Only 1 dispute can be filed per contract — File a Dispute button is hidden once a dispute has been submitted - Tab is read-only — no editing available from this view

title: View Evaluation
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view the evaluation submitted by my Team Builder after the trial so that I can understand their assessment of my performance and see my finalized Trial Fit Score.
ac: - Evaluation tab shows the full evaluation submitted by the Team Builder - Shows: overall star rating, written feedback, and overall recommendation - Finalized TFP score shown after evaluation - Read-only view

title: Send Message to Team Builder
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to send a message to my Team Builder directly from the trial dashboard so that I can communicate without leaving my contract view.
ac: - Send Message button is visible in the dashboard header at all times - Clicking opens the messaging interface with the Team Builder pre-selected - Independent Contractor can compose and send a message without leaving the dashboard - Empty message cannot be sent

title: View Full-Time Contract Overview
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my full-time contract dashboard so that I can monitor my ongoing performance, objectives, and contract details in one place.
ac: - Dashboard header shows: Team Builder company name, role, and contract status badge (Full-Time, Active) - Summary stats bar shows: Assigned Objectives count and Completed Objectives count - Trial Fit Score widget shows the final TFP from the completed trial — read-only, does not update - Objectives tab is the default view when the dashboard loads - Objectives list shows all objectives for the full-time engagement - Objectives are NOT locked — new objectives assigned by Team Builder appear in the list automatically - Each objective card displays: title, type badge (Manual / Automatic / Default), progress percentage, status pill, due date, and last update date - Clicking an objective card opens the relevant objective dashboard - Navigation tabs visible: Objectives, Contract & Payment, Evaluation - Send Message button visible in the header at all times - File a Dispute button visible in the header — available at any time during an active full-time contract

title: View Manual Objective Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a manual objective in my full-time contract and see my current value, trend chart, performance heatmap, discussions, and recent activity so that I can track my measurable progress over time.
ac: - Same functionality as Trial Manual Objective Dashboard - Dashboard shows: current value, daily target, progress %, trend chart, heatmap, discussions, recent activity - Update Progress button available to log a new value

title: Update Progress
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to update my progress on a manual objective in my full-time contract by entering a new value so that my Team Builder can see my latest performance.
ac: - Update Progress modal shows: objective title, type tag, daily target, current value, new value input - Independent Contractor enters new value and submits - Progress updates immediately in the dashboard and trend chart - Team Builder is notified of the update - Recent Activity log records the update with timestamp - Empty submission is not allowed

title: View Key Result Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a key result connected to an automatic objective in my full-time contract and view its progress so that I can understand what is driving the objective's completion.
ac: - Dashboard shows: Key Result title, type, progress percentage, remaining days, start and end dates - Connected tasks listed if the Key Result is Automatic - Discussions and Recent Activity visible

title: View Task Dashboard
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view and complete tasks under an automatic key result in my full-time contract so that I can drive my key result's progress forward.
ac: - Task Dashboard shows all tasks connected to an Automatic Key Result - Independent Contractor can mark tasks as done directly from this view - Marking done updates Key Result progress and Objective progress automatically

title: Mark as Done
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to mark a default objective or task as done in my full-time contract so that I can signal completion to my Team Builder and request approval.
ac: - Mark as Done available on Default objectives and Default tasks in full-time contract - Confirmation prompt shown before marking - Status changes to Pending Approval immediately - Team Builder is notified of the completion - Cannot be undone by Independent Contractor

title: View Contract & Payment Tab
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my full-time contract terms, salary, exclusive benefits, and payment history so that I can keep track of my compensation and financial activity.
ac: - Tab shows: agreed role, contract start date, base salary, exclusive benefits breakdown, and payment schedule - Exclusive benefits listed separately: Health Insurance, Government Contribution, Internet Allowance, Learning & Development Allowance - Payment history shows all recorded transactions with: date, transaction type, amount, and status - If a dispute has been filed for this contract, it is visible in this tab with: date filed, reason, and current status - Only 1 dispute can be filed per contract — File a Dispute button is hidden once a dispute has been submitted - Tab is read-only

title: View Evaluation Tab
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view all evaluations submitted by my Team Builder in the Evaluation tab so that I can track ongoing feedback and understand how I am being assessed.
ac: - Evaluation tab shows all evaluations submitted by the Team Builder during the full-time engagement - Each entry shows: date submitted, star rating, and written feedback - Read-only view

title: View Trial Fit Score
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my Trial Fit Score from my full-time contract dashboard so that I can reference the score that led to my full-time conversion.
ac: - TFP widget visible on Full-Time Contract Dashboard for reference - Shows the final score from the completed trial that led to full-time conversion - Read-only — score does not change after full-time contract begins

title: View Team Builder Company Profile
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view the Team Builder's company profile from my full-time contract dashboard so that I can stay informed about the company I work for.
ac: - Company profile shows: company logo, company name, description, industry, location, company URL, and work style badges - Read-only view from the contract dashboard

title: Send Message to Team Builder
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to send a message to my Team Builder directly from the full-time contract dashboard so that I can communicate without leaving my contract view.
ac: - Send Message button visible in the dashboard header at all times - Clicking opens the messaging interface with the Team Builder pre-selected - Empty message cannot be sent

title: Receive Payment
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to receive confirmation when my salary payment is recorded on schedule so that I know my earnings have been processed.
ac: - Independent Contractor receives in-app and email notification when salary payment is recorded - Notification includes: contract name, amount, and payment schedule period - Payment appears in Earnings → Transaction History immediately - Amount matches the agreed salary from the contract

title: File a Dispute
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to file a dispute at any point during my full-time engagement so that I can raise concerns about payment or the engagement.
ac: - File a Dispute button is available at any time during an active full-time contract - Only 1 dispute can be filed per contract — button is hidden after a dispute has been submitted - Dispute form requires: reason, description, amount in question, and supporting evidence (optional) - Allowed reason codes: Missing Deliverable, Out-of-Scope Output, Missed Deadline, No Report Submitted - Independent Contractor cannot submit without completing all required fields - Submitted dispute sent to Hireable admin for process check only - Team Builder is notified that a dispute has been filed - Filed dispute appears in the Contract & Payment tab of this contract - Filed dispute appears in Earnings → Sent Disputes with Pending status

title: View Earnings Overview
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a summary of my total earnings across all contracts so that I can quickly understand my overall payment activity on the platform.
ac: - Earnings page shows a summary card with: total amount received across all contracts - Summary is updated in real time as new transactions are recorded

title: View Transaction History
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see a full list of all payment transactions across all my contracts so that I can track my complete earnings history in one place.
ac: - Transaction History shows all recorded payment activity across all contracts - Each row shows: date, contract name, Team Builder company name, transaction type, amount, and status - Transaction types: Payment Received, Payment Refunded - Default sort by most recent - Pagination applied - Empty state shown if no transactions exist

title: Filter Transactions
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to filter my transactions by contract, status, and date range so that I can narrow down records to find what I am looking for.
ac: - Filter options: by contract name, by status (Received, Refunded), by date range - Filters can be combined - Active filters are visually indicated - Clearing filters restores the full list

title: Search Transactions
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to search my transactions so that I can quickly locate a specific payment record.
ac: - Search bar available on Earnings page - Searches by contract name or Team Builder company name - Results update dynamically as Independent Contractor types - Empty state shown when no results match

title: View Transaction Detail
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a specific transaction to view its full details so that I can verify the payment amount, source, and date.
ac: - Clicking a transaction opens the detail view - Shows: date, contract name, Team Builder company name, transaction type, amount, and status - Read-only view

title: View Sent Disputes
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to see all disputes I have filed across all contracts in one list so that I can monitor the status of each dispute.
ac: - Sent Disputes page shows all disputes filed by the Independent Contractor across all contracts - Each row shows: date filed, contract name, Team Builder company name, reason, and status (Pending / Resolved / Closed) - Default sort by most recent - Empty state shown if no disputes have been filed

title: View Dispute Detail
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to open a specific dispute to view its full details and status updates so that I can stay informed on the process check outcome.
ac: - Clicking a dispute opens the full detail view - Shows: date filed, contract name, Team Builder company name, reason, description, amount in question, supporting evidence, and current status - If resolved, shows: admin resolution notes and outcome - Read-only view

title: Withdraw Dispute
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to withdraw a pending dispute so that I can cancel it if the issue has been resolved or I have changed my mind.
ac: - Withdraw button is available on Pending disputes only - Confirmation prompt shown before withdrawing - Dispute status changes to Withdrawn - Hireable admin is notified of the withdrawal - Team Builder is notified that the dispute has been withdrawn - Once withdrawn, a new dispute cannot be filed for the same contract

title: View Profile
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my full profile so that I can see exactly how I appear to Team Builders.
ac: - Profile shows: photo, name, role, rate, experience level, location, website, LinkedIn, bio, workplace tags, skills, and performance history - Displays exactly how the profile appears to Team Builders - Edit and Retake Quiz buttons available

title: Edit Profile
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to edit my profile details such as photo, name, role, rate, experience level, location, website, and LinkedIn so that I can keep my professional information accurate and up to date.
ac: - Edit Profile form allows updating: photo, name, role, rate, experience level, location, website, LinkedIn - All changes saved immediately - Validation applied to required fields - Updated profile reflects immediately on Team Builder-facing view

title: Edit Bio
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to write and update my bio so that I can describe my background and value proposition to potential Team Builders.
ac: - Bio section shows current bio text - Edit Bio opens a text editor - Character limit applies (500 characters) - Changes saved immediately

title: View Workplace Tags
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my workplace tags derived from my work style quiz so that I can see the personality and work style badges that Team Builders see on my profile.
ac: - Workplace Tags section shows current tags derived from work style quiz - Tags are display-only and cannot be manually edited - Retake Quiz button available to update them

title: Retake Work Style Quiz
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to retake the work style quiz from my profile so that I can update my workplace tags if my working style or preferences have changed.
ac: - Retake Quiz button available on Profile page - Independent Contractor prompted to confirm before restarting - Completing quiz updates workplace tags/badges - New badges replace old ones immediately - Match % recalculates based on new work style results

title: Edit Skills
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to add or remove skills on my profile so that my skill set accurately reflects my current capabilities.
ac: - Edit Skills section shows current skills as tags - Independent Contractor can add new skills by typing and selecting from suggestions - Independent Contractor can remove skills by clicking the remove icon - Changes saved immediately - Updated skills reflect on Team Builder-facing profile

title: View Performance History
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view my performance history showing past evaluations, star ratings, and Team Builder feedback per contract so that I can track my professional growth.
ac: - Performance History section shows all past evaluations received - Each entry shows: company name, role, contract type (Trial / Full-Time), date, star rating, and written feedback - Visible to Team Builders viewing the profile - Read-only — Independent Contractor cannot edit or remove entries

title: View / Edit Account
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to view and edit my account information so that I can keep my basic account details current.
ac: - Account page shows: name, email, account type (Independent Contractor) - Independent Contractor can edit name and email - Email change requires re-verification - Changes saved immediately

title: Change Password
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to change my account password from the Security settings so that I can keep my account secure.
ac: - Form requires: current password, new password, confirm new password - New password must meet minimum requirements (8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number) - Incorrect current password shows an error - Success message shown after change

title: Add / Manage Payment Method
story: As an Independent Contractor, I want to add or manage my payment method so that I have a verified destination for receiving payments from the platform.
ac: - Payment Method page shows all saved payment methods - Independent Contractor can add new method, set default, or remove existing - Removal confirmation prompt shown - At least one payment method must remain active
